input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere; the only reference to \"insurance\" is in the taxes/charges sentence at p0051 (costs payable by Licensee), which imposes no coverage obligation on Licensor. Licensor hosts the trading Platform and handles Licensee data, so the playbook requires CGL, E&O and cyber coverage; the absence of any coverage falls below even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and approaches walk-away territory. Inserted a short insurance paragraph as General Provisions (l), immediately before the execution block, with certificates on request and a note offering fallback limits.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as our playbook requires commercial general liability, E&O and cyber coverage from a vendor that hosts the Platform and processes our data. We can discuss reduced limits (E&O USD 1,000,000 / cyber USD 2,000,000) if the stated amounts exceed Licensor's current program.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 for so long as Licensor hosts, accesses or processes Licensee's data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide certificates of insurance to Licensee on request.
